gear_talent_details.description: Whenever you or any ally's armor breaks, they gain 80% of your armor as bonus armor for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 45s. Killing an enemy with your specialization weapon removes this cooldown for all allies.

gear_talent_details.name: Abridged
gear_talent_details.description: If your Primary and Secondary weapon are not Exotic or Named and of the same type, the Secondary Weapon's talent will also be applied to the Primary Weapon. Doesn't apply to talents that include Weapon Swapping.

gear_talent_details.name: Aggressive Recon
gear_talent_details.description: Getting a Signature Weapon kill gives +15% Signature Weapon Damage for 10s and +25% Reload Speed for the next reload of the weapon (the bonuses do not stack). Automatically regenerate Signature Weapon Ammo every 60s.

gear_talent_details.name: Alternating Current
gear_talent_details.description: Generate a stack of 2.5% skill damage on one of your skills every second, capping at 10 stacks. After 10 seconds at the cap the stacks transfer to your other skill. The process then repeats ad-infinitum.

gear_talent_details.name: Apex Predator
gear_talent_details.description: Enemies within 15m receive a debuff, amplifying your weapon damage against them by +20%. Killing a debuffed enemy with your weapon disorients other enemies within 5m, and amplifies weapon damage by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

gear_talent_details.name: Bewildered
gear_talent_details.description: When dealing Weapon Damage to an enemy, 50% of the damage will be dealt to another enemy within 30m instead. When there are no enemies nearby, deal damage normally. Does not apply to Armor Plates.

gear_talent_details.name: Bleeding Edge
gear_talent_details.description: Shooting enemies within 15m applies bleed to the target. Repair 3-48% of your armor per second for every enemy that is bleeding within 15m. Repair strength per number of bleeding enemies: 1:3% 2:6% 3:12% 4:24% 5:48%

gear_talent_details.name: Bob and Weave
gear_talent_details.description: Receive repairs of 5% of your Total Armor for every 1m run in cover-to-cover. Damage taken while doing a cover-to-cover is healed over 10s.

gear_talent_details.name: Bond
gear_talent_details.description: Both you and Allies receive +30% Critical Hit Damage, +15% Skill Efficiency and +2% Armor Regen when an Ally is within 10m of you. Receive +15% Critical Hit Damage, +7.5% Skill Efficiency and +1% Armor Regen when one of your Skills is within 10m of you. Only the highest group of buffs can be active at one time.

gear_talent_details.name: Camaraderie
gear_talent_details.description: Shooting an enemy marks them for 10 seconds. When a marked enemy dies, receive one stack of 3% Weapon Damage and 3% Critical Hit Damage for each Ally or Skill that has contributed to killing that enemy. Max stacks is 35. Stacks decay every 10 seconds. Maximum amount of marks that can be placed is 4.

gear_talent_details.name: Challenger
gear_talent_details.description: Recieve +25% Damage resistance from enemies within 20m.

gear_talent_details.name: Charging
gear_talent_details.description: For each second spent out of cover during combat, Agents will get 5% reduced incoming skill damage. Max 50%. Charged: While fully charged, gain immunity to any movement speed debuff and share this with all of the agents hazard protection and the incoming skill damage with all allies for 10 seconds. After Charged is consumed, Charging buff will resume if still in combat and out of cover.

gear_talent_details.name: Chemical Agent
gear_talent_details.description: Catalysis: Dealing and receiving status effects (Burn, Bleed, Shock, EMP/Disrupt, Poison and blind/disorient) builds stacks of Catalysis to a maximum of 12. Each stack grants: +2% Weapon Damage, +2% Status Effects. Each enemy within 25 Meters that is affected by a status effect grants +1 stack/sec. Being affected by status effects grants +2 stacks/sec. Stacks decay at 1 stack/sec after 5s if no enemies in the radius or you are affected by status effects. Reactant: At max stacks, killing a status-affected enemy grants bonuses for 5s: +25% bonus armor.

gear_talent_details.name: Combat Medic
gear_talent_details.description: +80% Revive Speed. -50% Weakened Debuff timer. +45% Hive efficiency. Provides +50% damage resistance to both agents while reviving or being revived, and for 5s after a successful Hive Revive, or 10s after a Manual Revive. Any successful revives provide +1 Skill tier for 5s. Revives at skill tier 6 grant Overcharge for 15s.

gear_talent_details.name: Core Exercise
gear_talent_details.description: For each Core attribute, receive 40% of the other two Core Attributes' bonuses. Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when these bonuses are applied. All pieces from this Gear Set, apart from the Backpack, will feature random Core Attributes.

gear_talent_details.name: Counter
gear_talent_details.description: Swapping weapons will give the following groups of bonuses one by one, in order: 1. +20% Rate of Fire, +20% Weapon Damage. 2. +50% Magazine Size, +50% Reload Speed. The bonuses remain active for 12s or until the next weapon swap. Swapping to your sidearm will not trigger the next group of bonuses.

gear_talent_details.name: Crowd Control
gear_talent_details.description: Critical hits mark enemies for 20s, up to 3 marks total. When you critically hit a marked enemy, all other marked enemies take 60% of the damage dealt. Whenever a marked enemy dies, gain +10% critical hit damage, stacking up to 10 times, or until combat ends.

gear_talent_details.name: Dead Man's Hand
gear_talent_details.description: Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman rifle. After 5 cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by 75%. More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed. Four of a Kind: 4 shots. Full House: 3 shots. Aces and Eights: 2 shots. Flip an additional card on headshots.

gear_talent_details.name: Defibrillator
gear_talent_details.description: While "Shocker Punch" is equipped, the stun received by the agent from the Shock status effect will be reduced by 50%. Using a shield will give 100% to melee damage. Using St. Elmo's Engine with the holster will give 100% extra melee damage and will make the next melee attack apply shock to the target. Using all three items will offer all of the above mentioned bonuses and the Shock from the melee attack will have a 5m radius, starting from the first target. 15 second cooldown.

gear_talent_details.name: Dragon's Glare
gear_talent_details.description: While in combat, applies burn to the enemy closest to you within 20m. Cooldown: 35s.

gear_talent_details.name: Escape Plan
gear_talent_details.description: +20% Movement Speed.

gear_talent_details.name: Feedback Loop
gear_talent_details.description: Whenever you use or cancel a skill, your other skill's cooldown is reduced by 30s, total skill repair is increased by 10% for 20s, and total skill damage is increased by 10% for 20s. Cooldown: 10s.

gear_talent_details.name: Fireworks Show
gear_talent_details.description: Concussion grenades become Festive Grenades. Hitting an enemy with a Festive Grenade will cause explosions to happen around two other enemies within 20m. 10m in pvp. *Dealing 15% damage in PVP.

gear_talent_details.name: Flurry
gear_talent_details.description: Status effects apply snowfall to target.

gear_talent_details.name: From the Shadows Into the Light
gear_talent_details.description: From the Shadows: While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed. Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover. Into the Light: While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 1.2% Critical damage increase and 0.4% RPM. Buff does not apply while shooting from cover. While out of cover Agents lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.

gear_talent_details.name: Ground Control
gear_talent_details.description: Increases you and your allies' total weapon and skill damage by 15% when at full armor. When you repair an ally, you and all allies within 5m of you are also repaired for 60% of that amount.

gear_talent_details.name: Hackstep Protocol
gear_talent_details.description: Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability. Grants 50% bonus armor for 5s. Hides your nameplate for 5s. Repairs 20% of your armor. Increases total weapon damage by 2% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%. Ability cooldown: 20s.

gear_talent_details.name: Headache
gear_talent_details.description: First Headshot with a Marksman Rifle will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a Marksman Rifle will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine. From the fourth headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

gear_talent_details.name: Heartstopper
gear_talent_details.description: Headshots apply pulse for 5s. Weapon hits on pulsed enemies add and refresh a stack of +1% bonus armor and +1.1% amplified weapon damage to pulsed enemies for 5s. Max stack is 50. Two stacks are lost per second.

gear_talent_details.name: Hoarder
gear_talent_details.description: +3 Grenade Capacity. +50% Grenade Radius. +35% Grenade Damage. +25% Grenade Damage for each extra enemy caught in the blast. Automatically regenerate grenades every 30s, if you have less than 2 grenades in your inventory.

gear_talent_details.name: Huddle
gear_talent_details.description: Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent that is within the range of the hive or Smart Cover. While at Skill Tier 6, having at least one ally Agent in the range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4s will grant Overcharge for 15s. Cooldown: 40s. Mortars and enemy Skills that enter the range of your Hive or Smart Cover will be destroyed. Cooldown: 10s. The cooldown is 20% faster for each ally agent within the range of your hive or smart cover.

gear_talent_details.name: Impervious
gear_talent_details.description: Both you and Allies within 10m of you receive +40% Hazard Protection.

gear_talent_details.name: Indirect Transmission
gear_talent_details.description: On kill: Spread status effects of that enemy to all enemies within 10m. Refresh 50% of status effect durations.

gear_talent_details.name: Iron Grip
gear_talent_details.description: +50% Weapon Handling.

gear_talent_details.name: Kill Confirmed
gear_talent_details.description: Enemies you kill drop a trophy on death. Collecting trophies provides both a short and long term buff, the first of which scales with the number of core attributes equipped and lasts 10s. Red Core - 5% Weapon Damage. Blue Core - 10% Bonus Armor. Yellow Core - 5% Skill Efficiency. For every trophy collected gain an additional +1% weapon damage, +1% skill efficiency and +0.1% armor regeneration for 300s. Maximum 30 stacks.

gear_talent_details.name: Makeshift Repairs
gear_talent_details.description: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 25% of that amount is repaired to both over 10s.

gear_talent_details.name: On Point
gear_talent_details.description: Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Reloading will grant +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack, for 20s.  No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will refill your magazine.  Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine.

gear_talent_details.name: One in the Hand... / ...Two in the Bag
gear_talent_details.description: Throwing a grenade refunds it and grants +1 skill tier for 15s. Grants overcharge if already at skill tier 6. Cooldown: 60s. +1 Armor Kit Capacity. +3 Grenade Capacity. +25% Ammo Capacity. +10% Repair-Skills. +10% Status Effects.

gear_talent_details.name: Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype
gear_talent_details.description: The Incinerator Turret spins 360 degrees. You are immune to your own Incinerator Turret's fire. The Incinerator Turret explodes when disabled.

gear_talent_details.name: Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype
gear_talent_details.description: Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%. Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 10s.

gear_talent_details.name: Ostracize
gear_talent_details.description: Shooting an enemy applies a mark. Only one mark can be active at a time. The mark disappears after 15s, or when the marked enemy dies. Receive 600% Amplified Damage from the marked enemy. Deal 30% Amplified Damage to unmarked enemies. If only one enemy remains in combat, the mark disappears and cannot be reapplied.

gear_talent_details.name: Over the top
gear_talent_details.description: Damaging an enemy with a grenade or striking an enemy with a melee attack, activates Seeing Red. Seeing Red grants +25% total weapon damage and +100% melee damage. Seeing Red lasts 20 seconds and starts a 60 second cooldown after completion. While in cooldown, damaging an enemy with a melee attack or hitting an enemy with the effect of a grenade will complete the cooldown instantly.

gear_talent_details.name: Pack Instincts
gear_talent_details.description: You and all allies gain a bonus based on the distance of the last enemy you hit. 0-15m: +25% critical hit damage. 15-25m: +10% critical hit chance and +10% critical hit damage. 25m+: +25% critical hit chance.

gear_talent_details.name: Parkour!
gear_talent_details.description: Performing a cover to cover or vaulting reloads your drawn weapon and grants +25% bonus armor for 5s.

gear_talent_details.name: Quick Draw
gear_talent_details.description: While your pistol is holstered, gain a stacking buff every 0.3s, up to 100. When you swap to it, your first shot consumes the buff and deals +10% damage per stack. This deals headshot damage to anywhere you hit.

gear_talent_details.name: Rebalance
gear_talent_details.description: Getting kills and hitting enemies 3 times build Red stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Weapon Damage. Getting hit 3 times builds Blue stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Damage Resistance. Upon reaching 80 stacks in total, lose all stacks and receive a separate bonus of 0.5% Damage Resistance per Red stack and 0.5% Weapon Damage per Blue stack until the next time the stack cap is reached.

gear_talent_details.name: Red, White and Blue
gear_talent_details.description: Enemies you shoot receive stacking debuffs of Red/White/Blue. Changes every 2 seconds. Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%. White: Hitting the enemy restores you and your allies' armor by 2% once every second. Blue: Decreases enemy damage dealt by 10%. Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all three debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. Explosion strength is reduced on Named enemy deaths.

gear_talent_details.name: Resourceful
gear_talent_details.description: Slots in with any equipped Gear Set and/or Brand Set item to fulfill a requirement towards unlocking a Gear and/or Brand Sets bonus. Can unlock bonuses from multiple sets simultaneously.

gear_talent_details.name: Return to Sender
gear_talent_details.description: For PvE: Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 20% of the damage dealt by your Skills. For PvP: Receive repairs of 5% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills.

gear_talent_details.name: Rules of Engagement
gear_talent_details.description: Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark. Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of Hollow-Point Ammo for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party. Mark lasts for 10 seconds. Hollow-Point Ammo amplifies weapon damage by 40% and applies bleed on hit.

gear_talent_details.name: Slotted
gear_talent_details.description: Receive bonuses for each non-Core Attribute on this item, depending on their color: Red: +10% Critical Hit Damage. Yellow: +5% Skill Efficiency. Blue: +1% Armor Regen. This item can feature any Core Attribute. This item features a third random Attribute instead of having a Gear Mod Slot. This item cannot feature the Headshot Damage, Health, or Skill Repair Attributes.

gear_talent_details.name: Smoke Screen
gear_talent_details.description: On Armor break, drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet, concealing you from enemies for 3s. Cooldown: 40s.

gear_talent_details.name: Stand Your Ground
gear_talent_details.description: Cannot be staggered by explosions. Increases total weapon damage by 3% each second you are not moving. Stacks up to 10 until you start moving. All stacks lost 10s after moving.

gear_talent_details.name: Stoic
gear_talent_details.description: Get +4% Damage Resistance for every enemy that is targeting you. The bonus is multiplied by 1.X, where X is the number of agents in your group.

gear_talent_details.name: Striker's Gamble
gear_talent_details.description: Weapon hits amplify total weapon damage by 0.65%, stacking up to 100 times. 1 stack lost per second between 0 to 50 stacks; 2 stacks lost per second between 51 and 100 stacks.

gear_talent_details.name: Symphony
gear_talent_details.description: Kills Beyond 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns, SMGs, and Pistols; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +25% Bonus Armor for 15s. Kills Within 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Marksman Rifles and Rifles; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s. Intermittently killing enemies from both ranges builds up stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5 and triggered simultaneously for 15s. No stacks gained while talent is active.

gear_talent_details.name: Tend and Befriend
gear_talent_details.description: Interacting with your deployed skills grants the skill 25% skill damage for 10s. This buff cannot be refreshed. Interactions include: Using / Deploying the Skill, Changing the skills target, Healing the skill.

gear_talent_details.name: Throttle Control
gear_talent_details.description: Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage. Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.

gear_talent_details.name: Toxic Delivery
gear_talent_details.description: Status effects also apply a damage over time debuff for 10s. Total Damage dealt is equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage and increased by your status effect attributes.

gear_talent_details.name: Transference Overclock
gear_talent_details.description: Grants 15% Hive skill haste per skill tier. Detonating a hive refreshes your skill cooldowns and grants overcharge for 15s. If at Skill Tier 6, this effect also applies to all allies. Allies receiving this effect are unable to benefit from it again for 120s.

gear_talent_details.name: Vicious Cycle
gear_talent_details.description: Taking damage builds stacks to a cap of 30. Each stack grants 1.5% Weapon Damage. Taking damage at max stacks triggers a purge, removing all stacks and Status Effects and then dropping a healing cloud which restores 5% of Max Armor for 10s to all allies in the cloud.

gear_talent_details.name: Weakest Link
gear_talent_details.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 30% to the lowest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy. Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder. Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator. Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy.

gear_talent_details.name: Spontaneous Combustion
gear_talent_details.description: Every Status Effect you apply has a 40% chance of also applying Burn to the enemy. If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive +25% Burn Damage for the duration of the Burn

gear_talent_details.name: Flashpoint
gear_talent_details.description: Increase the chance of applying Burn of Spontaneous Combustion to 60%

gear_talent_details.name: White Hot
gear_talent_details.description: Increase the Duration of the Burn Damage debuff of Spontaneous Combustion by +50%

gear_talent_details.name: Resolved
gear_talent_details.description: Your next body shot will be considered a headshot. Cooldown: 2s Requires Equipped: Marksman Rifle, Rifle or Pistol

gear_talent_details.name: Decoy King
gear_talent_details.description: While in combat, the Moon will cycle through its phases every 5s. There are 8 Moon phases. Starting from a New Moon, weapon damage you deal will be Amplified by 5%. The value of the Amplifier will increase by 5% each phase until reaching 25% during a Full Moon, then it will decrease as the Moon return to being a New Moon, restarting the cycle. During a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Breadbasket
weapon_talent_details.description: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +55% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 3.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Breadbasket
weapon_talent_details.description: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +70% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 2.

weapon_talent_details.name: Killer
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +70% critical hit damage for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Killer
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +90% critical hit damage for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Preservation
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing an enemy repairs 10% armor over 5s. Headshot kills improve the repair by an additional 10%

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Preservation
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing an enemy repairs 15% armor over 5s. Headshot kills improve the repair by an additional 15%

weapon_talent_details.name: Optimist
weapon_talent_details.description: Weapon damage is increased by +3.5% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine. (Bonus is linear across every round)

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Optimist
weapon_talent_details.description: Weapon damage is increased by +4.5% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine. (Bonus is linear across every round)

weapon_talent_details.name: Strained
weapon_talent_details.description: Gain 10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s you are firing. Stacks up to 5 times.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Strained
weapon_talent_details.description: Gain 10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s you are firing. Stacks up to 8 times.

weapon_talent_details.name: Close & Personal
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing a target within 7m grants +30% weapon damage for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Close & Personal
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing a target within 7m grants +38% weapon damage for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Fast Hands
weapon_talent_details.description: Critical hits add a stack of 3% reload speed bonus. Max stack is 40.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Fast Hands
weapon_talent_details.description: Critical hits add a stack of 5% reload speed bonus. Max stack is 40.

weapon_talent_details.name: Sadist
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to bleeding enemies. After 4 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Sadist
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies +35% weapon damage to bleeding enemies. After 3 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Eyeless
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to blinded enemies. After 4 kills, applies blind to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Eyeless
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies +35% weapon damage to blinded enemies. After 3 kills, applies blind to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Ignited
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies +25% weapon damage to burning enemies.  After 4 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Ignited
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to burning enemies. After 3 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Vindictive
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing an enemy with a status effect applied grants you and all allies within 15m 16% Critical hit chance and 16% critical hit damage for 20s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Vindictive
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing an enemy with a status effect applied grants you and all allies within 20m 21% Critical hit chance and 21% critical hit damage for 20s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Ranger
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 4m you are away from your target.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Ranger
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 3m you are away from your target.

weapon_talent_details.name: Steady Handed
weapon_talent_details.description: Hits grant a stack of +1% Accuracy and Stability. At 100 stacks, consumes stacks to refill the magazine.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Steady Handed
weapon_talent_details.description: Hits grant a stack of +1% Accuracy and Stability. At 75 stacks, consumes stacks to refill the magazine.

weapon_talent_details.name: Spike
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshots grant +20% skill damage for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Spike
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshots grant +25% skill damage for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perpetuation
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshots grant +75% status effect damage and duration to the next status effect you apply. Cooldown: 20s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Perpetuation
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshots grant +75% status effect damage and duration to the next status effect you apply. Cooldown: 16s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Reformation
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshots grant +60% skill repair for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Reformation
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshots grant +80% skill repair for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Future Perfect
weapon_talent_details.description: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 15s. Stacks up to 3 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge Cooldown: 90s

weapon_talent_details.name: Future Perfection
weapon_talent_details.description: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 19s. Stacks up to 4 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge Cooldown: 90s

weapon_talent_details.name: Flatline
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to pulsed enemies. After 4 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Flatline
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to pulsed enemies. After 3 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Sledgehammer
weapon_talent_details.description: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 15% more damage to armor from the agent that applied the mark and have a -20% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Sledgehammer
weapon_talent_details.description: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 20% more damage to armor from the agent that applied the mark and have a -30% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

weapon_talent_details.name: Thunder Strike
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies 30% extra damage to shocked targets. After 4 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Thunder Strike
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies 35% extra damage to shocked targets. After 3 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: In Sync
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting an enemy grants +15% skill damage for 5s. Using a skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +15% weapon damage for 5s. Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect In Sync
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting an enemy grants +20% skill damage for 5s. Using a skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +20% weapon damage for 5s. Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

weapon_talent_details.name: Pressure Point
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to enemies under status effects.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Pressure Point
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to enemies under status effects.

weapon_talent_details.name: Streamline
weapon_talent_details.description: Increase Weapon Damage by 42% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Streamline
weapon_talent_details.description: Increase Weapon Damage by 47% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

weapon_talent_details.name: Immobilize
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to ensared enemies. After 4 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Immobilize
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 25% to ensared enemies. After 3 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Soft Spot
weapon_talent_details.description: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 19% Weapon Damage for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Soft Spot
weapon_talent_details.description: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 24% Weapon Damage for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Rifleman
weapon_talent_details.description: Landing headshots adds a stack of bonus +10% weapon damage for 5s. Max stack is 5. Additional headshots refresh the duration.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Rifleman
weapon_talent_details.description: Landing headshots adds a stack of bonus +11% weapon damage for 5s. Max stack is 6. Additional headshots refresh the duration.

weapon_talent_details.name: Boomerang
weapon_talent_details.description: Critical hits have a 50% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot gains 40% increased damage.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Boomerang
weapon_talent_details.description: Critical hits have a 75% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot gains 50% increased damage.

weapon_talent_details.name: Lucky Shot
weapon_talent_details.description: Magazine capacity is increased by 20%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Lucky Shot
weapon_talent_details.description: Magazine capacity is increased by 30%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

weapon_talent_details.name: Determined
weapon_talent_details.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed headshot.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Determined
weapon_talent_details.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed (critical) headshot.

weapon_talent_details.name: Behind You
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by +20% to enemies that are not targeting you.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Behind You
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies weapon damage by +25% to enemies that are not targeting you.

weapon_talent_details.name: Precision Strike
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 3. Hitting an enemy within 20m will use stacks to provide 20% amplified damage per stack to enemies within 20m for 5s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Precision Strike
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 2. Hitting an enemy within 20m will use stacks to provide 35% amplified damage per stack to enemies within 20m for 5s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Near Sighted
weapon_talent_details.description: Receive +80% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Near Sighted
weapon_talent_details.description: Receive +100% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

weapon_talent_details.name: On Empty
weapon_talent_details.description: Reloading from empty grants +60% weapon handling for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect On Empty
weapon_talent_details.description: Reloading from empty grants +80% weapon handling for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Measured
weapon_talent_details.description: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -25% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and +30% total weapon damage.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Measured
weapon_talent_details.description: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -30% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and +38% total weapon damage.

weapon_talent_details.name: Overflowing
weapon_talent_details.description: Every 3 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Overflowing
weapon_talent_details.description: Every 2 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

weapon_talent_details.name: Stabilize
weapon_talent_details.description: Firing your weapon increases Weapon Accuracy by 1% and Weapon Stability by 1% per shot up to 60%. If you stop firing, the bonuses reset after 4 seconds.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Stabilize
weapon_talent_details.description: Firing your weapon increases Weapon Accuracy by 1% and Weapon Stability by 1% per shot up to 75%. If you stop firing, the bonuses reset after 6 seconds.

weapon_talent_details.name: Naked
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting an enemy with no armor grants +50% headshot damage for 5s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Naked
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting an enemy with no armor grants +50% headshot damage for 8s.

weapon_talent_details.name: First Blood
weapon_talent_details.description: If scoped, your first shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit. Requires a Scope with 8x magnification or higher.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect First Blood
weapon_talent_details.description: If scoped, your first 2 shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit. Requires a Scope with 8x magnification or higher.

weapon_talent_details.name: Outsider
weapon_talent_details.description: After killing an enemy, gain 100% optimal range and +100% accuracy for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Outsider
weapon_talent_details.description: After killing an enemy, gain 150% optimal range and +125% accuracy for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Unwavering
weapon_talent_details.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +300% weapon handling for 5s. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Unwavering
weapon_talent_details.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +400% weapon handling for 5s. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Unhinged
weapon_talent_details.description: Grants +18% weapon damage at the cost of -25% Stability and -25% Accuracy.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Unhinged
weapon_talent_details.description: Grants +22% weapon damage at the cost of -25% Stability and -25% Accuracy.

weapon_talent_details.name: Frenzy
weapon_talent_details.description: For every 10 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 9s when reloading from empty.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Frenzy
weapon_talent_details.description: For every 8 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 9s when reloading from empty.

weapon_talent_details.name: Overwhelm
weapon_talent_details.description: Suppressing an enemy, that is not currently suppressed, grants +10% weapon damage for 12 seconds. Max stack is 4.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Overwhelm
weapon_talent_details.description: Suppressing an enemy, that is not currently suppressed, grants +12% weapon damage for 12 seconds. Max stack is 4.

weapon_talent_details.name: Pummel
weapon_talent_details.description: 3 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Pummel
weapon_talent_details.description: 2 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Pumped Up
weapon_talent_details.description: Reloading grants +1.2% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 25 times.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Pumped Up
weapon_talent_details.description: Reloading grants +6% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 5 times.

weapon_talent_details.name: Brazen
weapon_talent_details.description: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 6 pellets hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Brazen
weapon_talent_details.description: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 4 pellets hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Salvage
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing a target has a +70% chance to refill the magazine.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Salvage
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing a target has a +85% chance to refill the magazine.

weapon_talent_details.name: Finisher
weapon_talent_details.description: Swapping from this weapon within 10s of killing an enemy grants 30% critical hit chance and 30% critical hit damage for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Finisher
weapon_talent_details.description: Swapping from this weapon within 10s of killing an enemy grants 35% critical hit chance and 40% critical hit damage for 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Back and Forth
weapon_talent_details.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +10% Rate of Fire and +9% Weapon Damage for 10s. Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonus groups will remove the other if it's still active. Two instances of this talent will not function at the same time.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Back and Forth
weapon_talent_details.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s. Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonus groups will remove the other if it's still active. Two instances of this talent will not function at the same time.

weapon_talent_details.name: Head Scratcher
weapon_talent_details.description: Deal 30% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 4 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Head Scratcher
weapon_talent_details.description: Deal 35% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 3 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Allegro
weapon_talent_details.description: 12% rate of fire.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Accurate
weapon_talent_details.description: 30% accuracy.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Extra
weapon_talent_details.description: +30% magazine capacity.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Distance
weapon_talent_details.description: +25% optimal range.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Jazz Hands
weapon_talent_details.description: 50% reload speed.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Optimized
weapon_talent_details.description: 20% weapon handling.

weapon_talent_details.name: Actum Est
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will give 1 stack. At 100 stacks the next magazine will be 100% filled with shock ammo.

weapon_talent_details.name: Adaptive Instincts
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting 30 headshots grants 20% critical hit chance and 50% critical hit damage for 45 seconds. Hitting 65 body shots grants 90% weapon damage for 45 seconds. Hitting 20 leg shots grants 150% reload speed for 45 seconds. Buffs refresh when out of combat.

weapon_talent_details.name: Agonizing Bite
weapon_talent_details.description: Diamondback randomly marks an enemy within 20m. If no enemies are within 20m, it marks the enemy closest to you. Hitting that enemy consumes the mark, guaranteeing a critical hit with damage amplified by 20%. After hitting a mark, all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 5 seconds. A new random enemy is marked afterwards and whenever you reload.

weapon_talent_details.name: Ardent
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting heats up the weapon, filling up heat meter. The meter is equivalent to 50% of the weapon's standard Magazine Size. When the meter is full, rounds shot by the weapon will ignite enemies. When not shooting, the meter depletes over time. Reloading or swapping the weapon fully depletes the meter.

weapon_talent_details.name: Autentico
weapon_talent_details.description: +35 Weapon Damage. +100% accuracy. No Damage Drop Off. These bonuses are built into the weapon's base stats.

weapon_talent_details.name: Big Game Hunter
weapon_talent_details.description: When scoped, switches to semi-automatic fire mode, dealing 450% weapon damage with each shot. Headshots grant +6% headshot damage. Stacks up to 25 times. Once at full stacks, 10 stacks decay every 4 seconds until all stacks have been removed. Headshots delay decaying of stacks.

weapon_talent_details.name: Binary Trigger
weapon_talent_details.description: This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack. At 7 stacks, shooting an enemy deals 500% amplified damage and creates a 7m explosion dealing 500% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

weapon_talent_details.name: Blossom Harvest
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 3.3% for each 10% combined Armor and Health the enemy has remaining.

weapon_talent_details.name: Breathe Free
weapon_talent_details.description: When moving, gain 4 stacks per second, or 8 stacks if sprinting. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Each round fired consumes a stack, amplifying damage by 75%. Kills grant +20% movement speed for 10s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Bullet Hell
weapon_talent_details.description: This weapon never needs to be reloaded. For every 100 bullets that hit an enemy, replenish some ammo to you and all your allies' reserves.

weapon_talent_details.name: Busy Little Bee
weapon_talent_details.description: Each shot to a different target will give 1 stack, up to 10, each stack will give 20% amplified weapon damage increase. Stacks will activate once the agent switches weapon and will last for 10 seconds.

weapon_talent_details.name: Caduceus
weapon_talent_details.description: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's dealt damage.

weapon_talent_details.name: Capacitance
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. After 5 seconds, stacks decay 1 per second. For each skill tier gain 7.5% Weapon Damage.

weapon_talent_details.name: Capitulate
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting an enemy applies -4% Movement Speed for each pellet hit for 5 seconds. Shooting the enemy again will reapply the stacks.

weapon_talent_details.name: Shakedown
weapon_talent_details.description: Body shots add 1 stack to the enemy for 10s. Max stacks: 4. Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks. This weapon deals +4% Amplified Damage per stack. Your next headshot on an enemy with stacks consumes all stacks, dealing +11% Amplified Damage per stack. Destroying an enemy's weakpoint causes them to take +30% Amplified Damage from you for 5s

weapon_talent_details.name: Cover Shooter
weapon_talent_details.description: Every bullet fired while in cover increases weapon damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15 seconds. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration. The bonus damage is canceled by reloading, swapping weapons, or exiting combat.

weapon_talent_details.name: Disruptor Rounds
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting an enemy marks that enemy and adds a stack to the agent up to a count of 50. Shooting a marked enemy refreshes the mark and adds stacks to the agent. When you deploy a non-shield skill, remove all stacks on agent and all marked targets trigger an effect. 1-10 Stacks: Pulse marked targets for 5 seconds. 11-25 Stacks: Pulse and Disrupt marked targets for 5 seconds. 26-49 Stacks: Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets for 5 seconds. 50 Stacks: Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets and all hostiles within 10 meters of the marked targets. This effect will trigger immediately if any marked enemy is killed.

weapon_talent_details.name: Doctor Home
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will apply a mark for 5 seconds. If a marked target is killed it will give a 50% armor repair kit which applies to the whole party. The kit will not give bonus armor.

weapon_talent_details.name: Eagle's Strike / Tenacity
weapon_talent_details.description: Accuracy increases as you continuously fire, up to 30%. Headshot kills grant the Tenacity buff for 15 seconds. The strength of Tenacity is increased by 1% for body shots and 5% for headshots. Tenacity: 40-80% of damage taken is delayed until the buff expires. All of the total delayed damage is reduced for each enemy killed while the buff is active, up to 100%.

weapon_talent_details.name: Electromagnetic Accelerator
weapon_talent_details.description: Shots fired deal 0-100% weapon damage based on how long the trigger is held before releasing.

weapon_talent_details.name: Faster Than Reloading
weapon_talent_details.description: Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it. While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads your Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied. Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.

weapon_talent_details.name: Full Stop
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 20. Headshots grant 2 stacks. Each stack grants 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage. On reload, clear all stacks and gain 5% of your max armor as temp armor for 10 seconds for each stack removed. Headshot kills with Dread Edict restore all bullets in the magazine. This does not count as a reload.

weapon_talent_details.name: Gangland Hit
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark. More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 4. This weapon deals +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 5% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own

weapon_talent_details.name: Geri and Freki
weapon_talent_details.description: On trigger pull, fire both barrels at once. When fired from the right shoulder, hits add offensive primers, and defensive primers when fired from the left shoulder. Hits from one shoulder will detonate all of the opposite shoulder's primers when present. When detonated, each offensive primer deals 100% weapon damage, while each defensive primer grants +4% bonus armor and +10% amplified damage to armor plates for 5s. Primer effectiveness is doubled at 10 stacks.

weapon_talent_details.name: Hidden Rock
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshots apply confuse. Cooldown 20s.

weapon_talent_details.name: High Priority Target
weapon_talent_details.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 125% to the highest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy. Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder. Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator. Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy.

weapon_talent_details.name: In Plain Sight
weapon_talent_details.description: Your scoped view displays additional information about enemies not targeting you. Headshot and weakpoint damage against enemies not targeting you is amplified by 65%. Headshot kills reset the cooldown of your Decoy Skill. This bonus will wait until the Decoy goes on cooldown if currently active.

weapon_talent_details.name: Incessant Chatter
weapon_talent_details.description: When you reload, rate of fire is increased by 25% for each enemy within 15m for the duration of that magazine. Max stacks: 5. Kills refill 50% of your magazine.

weapon_talent_details.name: Liberty or Death
weapon_talent_details.description: Hits grant +2% weapon damage. Stacks up to 30 times. Headshots consume all stacks, repairing your shield for 3% per stack.

weapon_talent_details.name: Mosquito Song
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players. At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor. Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

weapon_talent_details.name: Ortiz Assault Interface
weapon_talent_details.description: While scoped, the weapon will highlight a random body section of each enemy. The weapon amplifies damage by +60% Weapon Damage to highlighted body sections.

weapon_talent_details.name: Pakhan
weapon_talent_details.description: Each kill with this weapon gains a stack of 75% Base Magazine Size increase to the next magazine, up to 4 stacks.

weapon_talent_details.name: Payment in Kind
weapon_talent_details.description: Dealing damage to enemies adds a stack of 2% Critical Hit Damage, up to 100 stacks, lasting 10s. On reload apply a 10s bleed to yourself, which deals 0.5% armor damage per stack.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perturb
weapon_talent_details.description: While this weapon is holstered, generate 50% less Threat when shooting. Keeping this weapon holstered for 10s will Prime it. While primed, swapping to this weapon grants +25% Rate of Fire, +30% Weapon Damage and you generate 100% more Threat when Shooting for 20s. Swapping from this weapon before the timer ends removes the bonuses.

weapon_talent_details.name: Plague of the Outcasts
weapon_talent_details.description: Hits apply a debuff dealing 100% weapon damage over 10s. This stacks up to 50 times. Whenever an enemy dies with this debuff, the stacks are transferred to a nearby enemy within 25m.

weapon_talent_details.name: Primer Rounds
weapon_talent_details.description: Damaged enemies lose 50% burn resistance for 5 seconds.

weapon_talent_details.name: Regicide
weapon_talent_details.description: Headshot Kills create a 5m explosion, dealing 400% weapon damage and applying bleed to all enemies hit.

weapon_talent_details.name: Restrained
weapon_talent_details.description: The pistol is fully automatic and deals +25% Amplified Damage for 20s after your Shield gets broken.

weapon_talent_details.name: Rule Them All
weapon_talent_details.description: When the agent has a Status Effect applied to them, 50% of the ammo in their next magazine will apply the same Status Effect to their targets. This effect will only occur during combat.

weapon_talent_details.name: Sandman
weapon_talent_details.description: Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies. Cooldown: 15s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Septic Shock
weapon_talent_details.description: Shooting a target applies stacks of venom, which last for 10s. Increasing stacks add more severe debuffs to the target. 2 - Poison. 4 - Disorient. 6 - Shock. 9 - Target takes additional 20% damage (from all sources). Stacks no longer increase. Duration of Status Effects is based on percentage of pellets hit on applying shot.

weapon_talent_details.name: Sport Mode
weapon_talent_details.description: +20% Movement Speed. This bonus does not stack with other Movement Speed bonuses.

weapon_talent_details.name: Swift
weapon_talent_details.description: Performing a cover to cover grants +20% weapon damage for 20s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Symbiosis
weapon_talent_details.description: While having a Shield deployed, lose Shield Health at a rate of 10% per second. Your Shield receives repairs of 25% of the damage dealt by this weapon.

weapon_talent_details.name: The Trap
weapon_talent_details.description: Tags enemies when in scope (maximum 10). If Agent kills any marked target with a headshot, all other targets will have 50% (20% PVP) movement speed and receive burn for 10 seconds. Cooldown 30 seconds. Killing another enemy with a headshot will shorten the cooldown for 10 seconds. Targets are marked after 1 second in crosshair.

weapon_talent_details.name: Transfusion
weapon_talent_details.description: Hitting headshots builds stacks up to a max of 8. When shooting an Ally or Skill, repair them for 50% of the shot damage for each stack. Healed Allies receive 200% of your Repair Skills bonus as Bonus Armor for each stack for 10 seconds. All hits become guaranteed headshots for 8 seconds after healing an Ally or Skill while at maximum stacks.

weapon_talent_details.name: Unnerve
weapon_talent_details.description: Killing an enemy will apply a mark on every enemy within 20m of it. Multiple marks can be applied to the same enemy. Max number of marks that can be applied to an enemy is 5. All marks on an enemy will disappear 10s after the last one has been applied. Deal +15% Amplified Damage per mark to marked enemies.

weapon_talent_details.name: You can look...but you can't touch
weapon_talent_details.description: When out of combat, receive 10 stacks. This weapon deals +11% Amplified Damage per stack. 1 stack is automatically consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you receive. 1 stack replenishes every 3s.

weapon_talent_details.name: Boiling Point
weapon_talent_details.description: The first 53% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

weapon_talent_details.name: Perfect Boiling Point
weapon_talent_details.description: The first 48% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

weapon_talent_details.name: Dragon's Breath
weapon_talent_details.description: This weapon fires Dragon's Breath shells. Each shot has a 40% chance of applying Burn to the enemy. An enemy cannot be applied Burn if they are burning already. Weapon Damage is Amplified by 50% of your Status Effects bonus.

weapon_talent_details.name: Foam at the Mouth
weapon_talent_details.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot, applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit. Amplifies weapon damage by 25% to ensnared enemies.

weapon_talent_details.name: Refreshing
weapon_talent_details.description: The weapon fires a stream of water. Hitting an ally agent builds stacks on them. Max stack is 5. Stacks deplete every 2s. While having at least 1 stack, the ally will have +50% Hazard Protection.

weapon_talent_details.name: Run and Gun
weapon_talent_details.description: While moving, you accrue 5 stacks per second, up to a maximum of 100 stacks. Headshots with Lichtenberg grant 15 stacks and 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds. While at maximum stacks your next shot with Lichtenberg consumes all stacks, deals 200% bonus damage and Shocks the target for 2 seconds.

weapon_talent_details.name: Startling
weapon_talent_details.description: Whenever this weapon makes an enemy Suppressed, the enemy is applied Disorient, and you and allies receive +30% Damage to Targets Out of Cover for 15s.
